description: React component for the header of a SQL editor tab in the Superset frontend, including UI elements, state management, and actions for tab operations.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining props for the SqlEditorTabHeader component, including a QueryEditor object.

methods.name: renameTab
methods.description: Prompts user to enter a new tab title and updates the query editor title if provided.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns color based on query state and theme for status icon display.
